= Point

== Setup

.Schema
[source,graphql,schema=true]
----
type Photograph @node {
  id: String!
  size: Int!
  location: Point!
}

type Query {
  custom: String!
}
----

== enables query of a node with a wgs-84 point

 }

.GraphQL-Query
[source,graphql,request=true]
----
query Photographs($longitude: Float!, $latitude: Float!) {
  photographs(where: {location_EQ: {longitude: $longitude, latitude: $latitude}}) {
    id
    size
    location {
      latitude
      longitude
      height
      crs
    }
  }
}
